title: BioNumbers—the database of key numbers in molecular and cell biology
authors: Milo R, Jorgensen P, Moran U, Weber G, Springer M
funder: Systems Biology Department at Harvard Medical School, and Weizmann Institute of Science, Israel, to BioNumbers. Funding for open access charge: Personal research funds of corresponding author.
result: Curated database in which every number is taken from a cited literature source. Entry BNID 105606, read 2026-10-21: daily turnover of ATP in humans, 1 body weight a day, or about 60 kg. Its method, quoted from Buono and Kolkhorst (Advances in Physiology Education 2001), takes C6H12O6 + 6 O2 → 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + 36 ATP, so that 0.136 kg of ATP is resynthesised per litre of O2 consumed, and states that an average college student consumes 400 to 500 litres of O2 a day; the entry adds that Törnroth-Horsefield and Neutze (2008) give one body weight a day.
